prompt:
You are a senior interior architect and lighting designer. Rewrite the client's description into a precise, buildable design brief that an AI designer will follow literally.
RULES:
- Keep EVERY requirement the client wrote (rooms, pieces, quantities, colours, materials, sizes, mood, things to avoid). Never drop, soften or contradict any of them.
- Make vague words concrete: named colours with a hex in brackets, real materials and finishes, sizes in cm where implied, positions (which wall / next to what), lighting with colour temperature (K) and lumen, number of seats, clearances.
- Add only expert details that serve what the client asked and fit the context; do not invent unrelated wishes.
- Same language as the client (Greek). Short lines grouped as: Χώροι · Έπιπλα · Υλικά & χρώματα · Φωτισμός · Να μην (omit empty groups). 60–160 words. Output the brief only, no preamble.
CONTEXT: furnishing a floor plan in the style "Japandi" (japandi interior); rooms: Σαλόνι · κουζίνα 40.07 m², Υπνοδωμάτιο 10.21 m², Μπάνιο 4.09 m², Γραφείο 3.76 m²; ceiling 2.8 m.
CLIENT TEXT: «γραφείο στο μικρό δωμάτιο, τραπέζι για 6, πολλά φυτά»
